Use case: historical-scene. Asset: final photographic background for a mobile-first Chinese railway heritage experience, chapter 开山筑路, Chengdu–Chongqing Railway construction circa 1950–1952. This is a real-world photographic reconstruction, NOT an illustration, concept painting, CGI or theatrical fantasy.
SCENE: an unfinished single railway track in a believable Sichuan sandstone rock cutting. Two correctly spaced steel rails on roughly hewn wooden sleepers and natural crushed stone. Rock excavated manually, irregular tool marks, scattered believable freshly broken stones, a modest timber support at the distant side, humid wooded hills behind. No impossible monumental arch or tunnel cathedral.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION: camera exactly over the middle of the track, facing straight ahead, level roll; BOTH rails form a balanced symmetrical pair, their midpoint at precisely x=50% across the ENTIRE image. The vanishing point is exactly x=50%, y=45%. The foreground track is centered, never a single rail skewing diagonally across the frame. Its important action is concentrated within x=40–60%, y=30–70%, because the image will be center-cropped inside a narrow vertical door aperture. Keep the optical center of the dominant subject at x=50%, y=50%; do not use rule of thirds.
HUMANS AND TOOLS: two or three adult railway laborers on the sides of the track, all photographed strictly FROM BEHIND, in coarse faded 1950s cotton work jackets and trousers, cloth caps, natural full-body anatomy and working posture. One grips a long real steel chisel against a rock while the other raises a sensible wooden-handled sledgehammer, readable relation between hammer and chisel, others further away also back-facing. Back of heads only, ZERO visible eyes, faces or profiles anywhere. Workers and tools support the track rather than obscure its centerline. No modern safety vests, plastic helmets, power tools, excavators or electric overhead cables.
PHOTOGRAPHIC QUALITY: tactile steel mill marks, dusty textile weave and creases, broken granular sandstone, uneven timber grain; natural overcast daylight with soft directional shadow, realistic dynamic range, restrained earthy color, sharp physically credible detail through the central depth, subtle atmospheric perspective, documentary 35mm lens without exaggerated distortion. Full-bleed scene only. No paper texture, artificial aging, sepia filter, dramatic teal/orange grading, lens flare, fake film damage, text, caption, border, doorway, UI or watermark.
